         <rs type="work" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:5131">mtha' bral dbu ma'i rnam bzhag gsal byed sgron me</rs> 'dis | <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:7024">chos smra ba'i gshes bsnyen shes ldan gzu bor gnas pa'i don gnyer ba bstan 'dzin</rs> zhes pas nan gyi[s] bskul ba la brten nas | sde snod gsum dang <lb n="22b2"/> rgyud sde <expan>bzhi</expan> [la] | dgongs 'grel dang bcas pa la blo'i snang ba cung zad thob pa <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4674">rat+na kir+ti</rs> zhes bya bas | rang lo brgyad bcu lon pa me mo lugs gi lo smin drug zla ba'i dkar phyogs<note type="editorial">Kārttika śukla pakṣa</note> la <rs type="place" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:5699">dpal glang ri thang gi gtsug lag khang</rs> du sbyar ba rdzogs so || shu b+haM ||</seg></TEI>
